note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.40.0 and @effect-dynamodb/schema@1.40.0, installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local. Doc: { id, f } (and email under a unique constraint where the name says so), f as the name says, a sparse map stored under the prefix m; put with f holding what the name says, then one update holding a pathRemove the removal guard judges and another clause writing or removing in the same field, standalone or as the name says (in a transaction, on an entity with versioned: { retain: true }, with a unique constraint). For each, its outcome, every request it sent, whole and in order (reads included), every row of the table after it, and what get read back; the table's name is replaced by <table>, UUIDs and timestamps by <token> and <time>. Never regenerate it: it is the record of what 1.40.0 did.
